title: Pairwise disjointness of the collision pieces
statement: Fix a type $\alpha$, a natural number $k$, and two elements $x, y : \alpha$. For each value $a \in \{0, \dots, k-1\}$, let $C_a$ denote the set of hash functions $h : \alpha \to \{0, \dots, k-1\}$ with $h(x) = a$ and $h(y) = a$. Then the family $(C_a)_a$ is pairwise disjoint: whenever $a \ne b$, the sets $C_a$ and $C_b$ have empty intersection.
hypotheses_covered: conclusion: pairwise disjointness of the collision pieces over a : Fin k
replaced:
For any $x, y : \alpha$ and $k$, the sets $\texttt{collisionPiece}\,k\,x\,y\,a$ for
$a : \mathrm{Fin}\,k$ are pairwise disjoint: if $a \ne b$ then
$\texttt{collisionPiece}\,k\,x\,y\,a \cap \texttt{collisionPiece}\,k\,x\,y\,b = \emptyset$.
